text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SEV2 triggered — elevated 429/503 rate from EU inference cluster. Link: https://datadog.example.com/incident/2912345678
Alex: I'm on it. seeing 503 spikes correlate with embeddings route, eu-west-1. 503s up ~6x in last 8m, 429s creeping.
Maria: I can join. traffic is mostly from a handful of tenants — one tenant showing extremely high concurrent KV cache miss patterns.
Sam: Looks like a client started a large backfill; requests are long seqs, p95 generation length 4.2k tokens. KV cache thrashing.
Jamie: Can we quickly throttle that tenant to avoid global impact?
Alex: Yes. I'm going to apply a soft quota and reduce max-concurrent for that tenant. Doing via admin API now.
Alex: ```bash
# apply tenant soft quota (temporary)
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/tenants/tenant-824/action \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"set_soft_quota","concurrency":6,"qps":20}'
```
Maria: Received. Pushed a quick feature flag to disable unbatched streaming on embeddings route for eu-west-1. Should cut down per-request overhead.
Sam: Running a dashboard query — errors.over_time{region:eu-west-1,code:503}. Graph shows clear drop in 503s after the throttle started ~2m ago but still elevated.
Alex: Also diverting traffic for non-critical routes to warm fallback model (gpt-small-quant). This should reduce GPU memory pressure.
Jamie: Noted. I'll message CS to prepare templated outreach for affected customers. Which tenants are impacted?
Maria: tenant-824 (major), tenant-311, tenant-099 — mostly embed-heavy. Sending list to CS now.
OncallRunner: Paging Pd escalation? do we need to page infra-sre?
Alex: Hold on escalation — mitigation in progress, but if 503s don't drop under 2x baseline in next 10m, escalate.
Sam: Adding temporary route-level rate cap via traffic-controller:
```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","region":"eu-west-1","caps":{"per_tenant_qps":20,"global_qps":500}}
```
Maria: Confirmed caps applied. DD dashboard shows inbound QPS for embeddings dropped ~35% right after.
Jamie: Customers list sent to CS with mitigation notes. CS will send targeted note to tenant-824 with suggested backoff and contact info.
Alex: Observability notes: check kv_cache.miss_rate and serve_time.p95. If miss_rate stays >40%, we may need to enable persistent KV warmups for that tenant.
Sam: Quick datapoint: p95 latency for generate dropped from 4.8s -> 3.1s post-diversion. 503s still ~2.8x baseline, 429s at 1.6x.
Maria: I'm spinning a short-lived extra pod pool for embedding workers in eu-west-1 to absorb burst — will be up in ~4m.
OncallRunner: Good. I'm updating the incident doc: https://confluence.example.com/incidents/2912345678 - adding timeline and actions.
Alex: If extra pool doesn't help, plan B: disable non-essential experimental features that increase model startup cost (cold-init hooks).
Jamie: CS wants ETA for full recovery to include in customer note. Best guess?
Sam: With current measures (soft quota + route caps + fallback model) we should reach steady state in 6-12 minutes, assuming no new client aggression.
Maria: Extra pool is coming up now (logs show scaling events).
Alex: 503s trending down — 1.9x baseline now. Keep monitoring.
OncallRunner: Tagging next on-call (rotation) for handoff at +30m. @OncallRunner will take over if no escalation.
Jamie: I'll prepare a follow-up message for customers: what we changed, expected recovery, mitigations to avoid (long unbatched requests).
Sam: Quick check: any downstream SLOs breached? Not yet — error budget still positive but shrinking.
Alex: I'm going to annotate the dashboard with the throttle and model-divert actions so post-mortem can tie impact to mitigations.
Maria: Extra pool at 80% healthy. 503s ~1.2x baseline, 429s ~1.1x. Looks like mitigation working.
Jamie: Sending customer note now, copying SRE contact.
Alex: I'll leave runbook and handoff notes in the incident doc, then hand to @OncallRunner for monitoring. If anything regresses, escalate to infra-sre.
OncallRunner: Acknowledged. Monitoring tilt on the errors chart, will watch next 45m and keep paging policy on.
Sam: Closing timeline: mitigation applied (soft quota, route caps, fallback model, extra pool). Postmortem: investigate KV cache behavior on long sequences and consider per-tenant warmups + auto-throttle heuristics.
Alex: Thanks all. Marking thread for follow-up postmortem. :white_check_mark:
